description: Relevant LLM Wiki memories must be mapped to the current plan, applied artifact, and verification evidence or explicitly excluded with a current-request reason before completion.

phases.before-action: Require a planned memory-to-action mapping, target, expected observation and stop condition before execution. Do not claim application or task completion.
phases.final: Default compatibility phase: require current task completion and actual action/verification evidence.

taskTraceConsumer: verify-llm-wiki-application.mjs --trace TASK.json must evaluate that exact trace and exit 2 on rejection; no arguments run the frozen regression suite.
requiredMemoryCoverage: Explicit requiredMemoryIds must be present, relevant, authorized and applied; this does not discover omitted IDs or enforce host calls.
